children: RNS Number : 9619B  Standard Chartered PLC  05 November 2026
5 November 2026
STANDARD CHARTERED PLC
ANNOUNCES CHANGES TO ITS BOARD

Standard Chartered PLC (the “Company”) today announces that Jackie Hunt has taken the decision, for personal reasons, to step down from the Board as an Independent Non-Executive Director and Chair of the Audit Committee, member of the Board Risk, Remuneration and Governance and Nomination Committees with effect from 31 December 2026.

The Company also announces that Lincoln Leong, Independent Non-Executive Director, will succeed Jackie as Chair of the Audit Committee from 1 January 2027, subject to regulatory approval.  He will also join the Board Risk, Remuneration and Governance and Nomination Committees on the same date.
Jackie Hunt said: “It has been a privilege to serve on the Board, and I have greatly valued my time with Standard Chartered.  I wish my colleagues and the Group every success for the future.”

Maria Ramos, Group Chair said “On behalf of the Board, I would like to thank Jackie for her valuable contribution to Standard Chartered.  We have greatly valued her experience, insight and considered contributions to the Board discussions, and wish her all the very best for the future.”
END
For further information, please contact:
Nick Probert
Group Media & Financial Communications
Additional Information – Jackie Hunt
There are no matters relating to Jackie Hunt stepping down from the Board that need to be brought to the attention of the shareholders of the Company.
